notes.title: Humble Bundle X Offers 6 Games Wot Are Quite Good
notes.content:
It’s almost hard to believe there was a time when we weren’t being constantly bombarded with cheap games, but it’s true. When I was a lad, I had to save up for two months, walk miles through snow to the nearest PC World, and turn my coins over for a game that probably wouldn’t even work. Now every hobo with a bindle is buying bundles of games for only a single week’s pocket money.

Humble Bundle X is the tenth bundle in the “main” series of Humble Bundles, and it contains To The Moon, Reus, Papa & Yo, Surgeon Simulator 2013, Bit.Trip Runner 2 and Joe Danger 2: The Movie. Which is a better, more interesting selection of games than I’ve seen in a bundle in a while. I’ve written more about each of them below.

notes.title: Humble Indie Bundle X includes Surgeon Simulator, Papo & Yo
notes.content: Humble Bundle is starting its 2014 with its tenth collection of indie games. Appropriately called Humble Indie Bundle X, this bundle will include up to six games, depending on how much you choose to pay. And as always, you can choose how much of your money goes to developers or charity.

notes.title: New DLC Available - Joe Danger 2: Undead Movie Pack, 20% off!
notes.content:
Joe Danger 2: Undead Movie Pack, all new content for Joe Danger 2: The Movie is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

Joe Danger, the world’s most determined stuntman, has started filming the scariest horror movie ever made! This eldritch add-on for Joe Danger 2: The Movie features:

- 15 horrifying new levels!
- Six terrifying new characters!
- Three blood-curdling new environments!
- Hunt brains as Zombie, sabotage dark rituals as the Vampire Hunter, and escape the creeping darkness as Pumpkin Head! Claim skulls as the Rider, run the gauntlet as the Chimpanzombie and tame the dreaded Werebear! Each character is also playable in the original game, adding a little Halloween flavour to every thrill and spill!

*Offer ends November 5 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Ducati Of The Dead: Joe Danger’s Undead Movie Pack
notes.content:
Is this some sort of joke? What the hell are they playing at? Halloween was last year. What’s to be gained from releasing a Halloween-themed game now, in this, the year of Luigi? Might as well put out a London Olympics update, Hello Games, if that is indeed your real name.

The Undead Movie Pack is the first DLC for comedy bike/harrowing personal injury escapade Joe Danger 2, and despite being a full 363 days late for the event it’s celebrating it goes the whole hog with six new toonishly spooksome characters. One of which, perfectly, is Ghost Rider. Though no doubt there are any number of careful differences included in order to keep hotshot Marvel lawyer Matt Murdoch from Hello’s door.

notes.title: Joe Danger 2 gets chased by Undead Movie Pack
notes.content: Joe Danger is adding another genre to his film repoitoire in Joe Danger 2: The Movie. A new 'Undead Movie Pack' adds horror flicks for Halloween, bringing with it more characters and stages with new dangers for Joe to outrun on his motorbike.

notes.title: Now Available - Joe Danger & Joe Danger 2: The Movie
notes.content:
Joe Danger and Joe Danger 2: The Movie are Now Available on Steam and are 20% off, or pick up the Joe Danger Bundle for 40% off!

Joe Danger, the world’s most determined stuntman, returns to embark on a death-defying thrill-ride across the set of the greatest blockbuster movie ever made. Across 100 crazy levels he’ll chase crooks by police bike, destroy laser-firing robots with a stolen jetpack, escape giant boulders in a minecart, time-travel to punch dinosaurs from a quad bike and divert nuclear missiles on a unicycle. Strap on the helmet of Joe Danger, impress the director and make action movie history!
